text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's District Development Fund will launch a massive rehabilitation of damaged roads and bridges ahead of this year's crop marketing season to improve transportation conditions for farmers.
- The president of the Preferential Trade Area Bank, Martin Ogang, arrived in Zimbabwe on Sunday to attend the bank's 13th annual general meeting, which begins in Harare on Monday.

- The Victoria Falls, one of the world's greatest tourist attractions, faces destruction if development in the resort town of the same name and tourist numbers remain uncontrolled, an industry official said last week.
